# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

blocks.text:
# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

The fix per the ticket:

**Generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context).

Wait — but `classify()` already detects 'run-concluded' zombies — a pending check-run whose backing run concluded non-cancelled past the 5-min grace. # Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

The fix per the ticket:

**Generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context).

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: crap4js gate (ratchet — baseline ${{ env.CRAP_THRESHOLD }})
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}"

blocks.text:
# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),

# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: crap4js gate (ratchet — baseline ${{ env.CRAP_THRESHOLD }})
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}"

# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

blocks.text:
# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

# gh-865: [BUG] Placeholder conclude misses numeric-id orphans: in_progress check-runs on CONCLUDED suites still pin required contexts (fa #1457 saga root cause)

## Description

Follow-up to #848 / #863 (which fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant). Full evidence: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/issues/848#issuecomment-6114638294

**Live failure (fa #1457, head fd1b9aa2, 2026-10-11, still BLOCKED):** run 38164305157 (push-triggered kicker workflow) completed/success at 18:33:24, yet its suite 103398997480 carries three pseudo-job check-runs stuck in_progress for 4+ hours: `Quality gate` (114566277295), `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (114566278905), `Binaries smoke gate` (114566280823). GitHub evaluates these placeholders for the required contexts → mergeStateStatus BLOCKED despite 4 green CI runs and repeated SM bridge-free success stamps on the same head.

**Root race:** rework push → kicker suite created instantly → SM dispatches CI only on its next tick (here +18 min) → GitHub's ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expires with no required-context stamps → placeholders minted ON THE KICKER'S SUITE with numeric run ids.

**Why #863's conclude misses them:** the detector keys on placeholders lacking numeric run ids; these have ids and a completed owning run.

**Required fix — generalized orphan rule:** an in_progress check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion) is definitionally orphaned → conclude it with the mirrored verdict, keeping the existing fail-safe (never conclude while a live run covers that head/context). This subsumes both variants.

**Prevention (optional, second layer):** shrink the race window — dispatch validation for reworked approved heads promptly (or have the kicker itself defer its suite), so required contexts are stamped before the ~10-13 min placeholder window closes. The conclude step stays the safety net.

**Acceptance:** on fa #1457's current head (or a synthetic reproduction: kicker suite + no required stamps for >13 min), a tick concludes the orphaned placeholders and mergeStateStatus flips from BLOCKED. Unit test: in_progress check-run + completed owning run + mirror verdict present → PATCH completed; owning run still in_progress → untouched.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);

arguments.content:
## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
