{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

{"content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2, three in_progress check-runs (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`) minted by the kicker suite with NUMERIC run ids pinned mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED for 4+ hours even though the owning kicker run 38164305157 had concluded success and 4 green CI runs stamped the same head.

**Root cause**: The in-place placeholder conclusion (gh-857, follow-up gh-863) detects ghosts via `checkRunZombies.placeholders()` / `smAgent.headPlaceholders()`, which keys exclusively on PENDING check-runs with NO numeric run id in their URL (`isPlaceholderShape`). The fd1b9aa2 variant carries numeric run ids (GitHub minted the placeholders on the kicker's suite run after the ~10-13 min speculative-placeholder window expired), so the detector skipped them. `classify()` does flag them as `run-concluded` zombies, but that path's only remedy is a same-sha re-dispatch — which cannot cure them (the required contexts stay pinned by the newest in_progress stamp per context), and the gh-857 conclude step never saw them.

**Impact**: Any PR head where GitHub mints run-linked in_progress placeholder check-runs on a suite whose owning run has concluded stays BLOCKED indefinitely despite green CI — the merge gate is ghost-held by stamps nothing will ever conclude.

**Fix approach**: Generalized orphan rule (gh-865): a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. New pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` in `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` + transport probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` in `js/smAgent.js`; the gh-857 conclude gate concludes placeholders AND these orphans together, keeping both fail-safes: never without a real completed-success green cover on the head (AC3 verdict mirror), never while any live run covers the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only (AC3); orphans that cannot be concluded fall through to the legacy same-sha re-dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id placeholder variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

arguments.content:
### Root Cause
- The gh-857/863 in-place placeholder conclusion detects ghosts only via `placeholders()`/`headPlaceholders()`, which requires a PENDING check-run with NO numeric run id (`isPlaceholderShape`).
- Live fa #1457 head fd1b9aa2: GitHub minted in_progress pseudo-job check-runs WITH run ids on the kicker suite (run 38164305157, concluded success) after the ~10-13 min speculative window expired — the detector skipped them, `classify()` only offered the same-sha re-dispatch, and the checks pinned `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` for 4+ hours with every real check green.

### Previous Attempt
- #863 (gh-857 in-place conclusion) fixed the no-numeric-id variant; insufficient because its detector required the ABSENCE of a run id, and these orphans have ids plus a completed owning run.

### Fix
- `js/common/checkRunZombies.js`: new pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()` — the generalized orphan rule: a pending check-run whose OWNING RUN has concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) is definitionally orphaned. Disjoint from the other detectors: no-run-id → gh-852 placeholder detector; owning run absent → classify `no-run` zombie (keeps the re-dispatch remedy); owning run active → AC2 untouched.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new probe `headOrphanedRunChecks()` (same transport contract: null = probe degraded); the gh-857 conclude gate now concludes placeholders AND orphans in one pass (`phTargets`), keeping both fail-safes — real completed-success green cover required (AC3 verdict mirror), no active run on the head (AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only; orphan-only heads that cannot conclude fall through to the legacy same-sha dispatch.

### Test Coverage
- `test_checkRunZombies.js`: 10 new `orphanedRunChecks` tests (fd1b9aa2 replay, 3-item multi-orphan, live/cancelled/absent/grace/probe-error/settled/link-less negatives, grace knob) — RED before, GREEN after.
- `test_smAgent.js`: 2 new `validate_pr` tests — green head + 3 numeric-id orphans → exactly 3 `PATCH` conclusions mirroring the green run, no reset, no re-dispatch; owning run still in_progress → zero PATCHes (AC2). RED before the wiring (verified via stash), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2595 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- Orphan conclusion mirrors the head's green verdict only — a cancelled/failed owning run never produces a green conclusion without a real green cover on the head.
- The optional second layer (dispatch validation promptly for reworked heads) is intentionally not implemented — the conclude step is the agreed safety net.

content.text:
Bug gh-865 fixed with TDD discipline. Summary:

**Root cause** — the gh-857/863 in-place placeholder conclusion (`placeholders()`/`headPlaceholders()`) only detects PENDING check-runs with **no numeric run id**. The fd1b9aa2 variant minted in_progress pseudo-job checks **with** run ids on the concluded kicker suite (38164305157), so the conclude step never saw them; `classify()` only offered the same-sha re-dispatch, which cannot cure a stamp nothing will ever conclude → BLOCKED for 4+ hours with green CI.

**Fix (generalized orphan rule)**
- `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` — new pure detector `orphanedRunChecks()`: pending check-run + owning run concluded (any conclusion, past the propagation grace) = orphaned. Deliberately disjoint from the existing detectors (absent run → `no-run` zombie keeps the re-dispatch remedy; active run → AC2 untouched; probe error → fail safe).
- `js/smAgent.js` — new `headOrphanedRunChecks()` probe (same null-on-degradation contract); the gh-857 gate concludes placeholders + orphans in one pass under the unchanged fail-safes (real completed-success green cover required — AC3; no live run on the head — AC2). The gh-852 fresh-sha reset stays keyed on link-less placeholders only; orphan-only heads that can't conclude fall through to the legacy same-sha dispatch.

**Tests**
